external_entities.name: Supplier
external_entities.description: A supplier that uploads compliance paperwork and signs in to the supplier document portal.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Suppliers upload their compliance paperwork through a portal

external_entities.name: Category manager
external_entities.description: A category manager who reviews uploaded compliance paperwork and approves or rejects it.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Our category managers, who work from the corporate network, review what has been uploaded and approve or reject it.

external_entities.name: Vendor
external_entities.description: The vendor that hosts the SaaS portal, issues supplier credentials, and pushes the nightly supplier data extract.
external_entities.source_excerpt: The portal is a SaaS product. The vendor hosts it

processes.name: Supplier document portal
processes.description: A vendor-hosted SaaS portal through which suppliers upload compliance paperwork and category managers review and approve or reject it.

processes.name: Supplier master service
processes.description: A service that loads the nightly supplier data extract and writes the records into the supplier database.
processes.source_excerpt: Our supplier master service loads that file and writes the records into the supplier database.

data_stores.name: Vendor platform
data_stores.description: The vendor's platform where uploaded compliance documents remain.
data_stores.source_excerpt: The documents themselves stay in the vendor's platform.

data_stores.name: Landing bucket
data_stores.description: A bucket in the organisation's cloud account receiving the nightly supplier data extract.
data_stores.source_excerpt: Every night the vendor pushes a supplier data extract to a landing bucket in our cloud account.
data_stores.notes: The runbook says the file arrives as a plain CSV and is picked up as-is.

data_stores.name: Supplier database
data_stores.description: A database in the organisation's cloud account holding records loaded from the supplier data extract.
data_stores.source_excerpt: Our supplier master service loads that file and writes the records into the supplier database.

data_flows.name: upload paperwork
data_flows.description: A supplier uploads insurance certificates, food safety audits, and contact details for its staff to the supplier document portal.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Suppliers upload their compliance paperwork through a portal — insurance certificates, food safety audits, and contact details for their own staff.
data_flows.data_description: Insurance certificates, food safety audits, and contact details for supplier staff

data_flows.name: store documents
data_flows.description: The supplier document portal stores uploaded compliance documents in the vendor platform.
data_flows.source_excerpt: The documents themselves stay in the vendor's platform.

data_flows.name: review paperwork
data_flows.description: The supplier document portal presents uploaded paperwork to category managers for review and approval or rejection.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Our category managers, who work from the corporate network, review what has been uploaded and approve or reject it.
data_flows.data_description: Uploaded compliance paperwork and approval or rejection decision

data_flows.name: push extract
data_flows.description: The vendor pushes a nightly supplier data extract to the landing bucket.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Every night the vendor pushes a supplier data extract to a landing bucket in our cloud account.
data_flows.notes: The source says, "We were told the nightly extract is encrypted end to end." The runbook says, "the file arrives as a plain CSV and is picked up as-is." These are conflicting positive claims about encryption in transit.

data_flows.name: load file
data_flows.description: The supplier master service loads the nightly file from the landing bucket.
data_flows.source_excerpt: Our supplier master service loads that file

data_flows.name: write records
data_flows.description: The supplier master service writes supplier records into the supplier database.
data_flows.source_excerpt: writes the records into the supplier database
data_flows.data_description: Supplier records from the nightly extract

trust_boundaries.name: Vendor hosting
trust_boundaries.description: The vendor-hosted environment containing the supplier document portal and vendor platform.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: The portal is a SaaS product. The vendor hosts it

trust_boundaries.name: Corporate network
trust_boundaries.description: The corporate network from which category managers work.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: Our category managers, who work from the corporate network

trust_boundaries.name: Our cloud account
trust_boundaries.description: The organisation's cloud account containing the landing bucket, supplier master service, and supplier database.
trust_boundaries.source_excerpt: The bucket, the service and the database are all in our cloud account.

assumptions.assumption: The compliance documents and supplier records are confidential because they include contact details for supplier staff and commercially sensitive compliance paperwork.
assumptions.basis: The vendor platform stores insurance certificates, food safety audits, and contact details for supplier staff.

assumptions.assumption: The supplier data extract is confidential because it contains supplier data, including contact details for supplier staff.
assumptions.basis: The landing bucket receives the nightly supplier data extract.

assumptions.assumption: The supplier database records are confidential because they originate from the supplier data extract, which includes supplier data and contact details for supplier staff.
assumptions.basis: The supplier master service writes records from the supplier data extract into the supplier database.
